The final evidence contains three split seeds (4001, 4009, 4021), two holdout conditions, 48 target rows per condition-seed, four checkpoints (1,2,4,8), original/permuted arms, and a zero-weight reset replay.
claims.scope: Conditions within one embedding benchmark source, not multiple independent datasets.

claims.claim: The final source is pinned English MTEB; panels have 48 benchmark-context columns, eight never-queryable audit columns, 88-99 historical rows, and at least four recorded audit cells per held-out row. Availability and content grouping constrain the population; name-defined families are lineage proxies.
claims.source_scope: Final source ID identifies the evaluated observations; readable manifest and evaluator substantively support protocol settings, not the evaluation hash alone.

claims.claim: Scalar scores are normalized using declared metric bounds, including (s+1)/2 for signed Spearman; dataset revision stays part of column identity, no imputed cell is a scored target, and no held-out extrema define normalization.

Observed-data factor fitting, Gaussian conditional prediction, bounded mixture median prediction, and moment-matched off-diagonal transfer rules are implemented in the selected preserved source. Equation-level optimality applies to the fitted distribution, not real-data Bayes optimality. Dense row-state covariance storage and rank-one updates have quadratic benchmark-count complexity.
claims.source_scope: Registry IDs and selection manifest establish provenance; readable code is the substantive implementation evidence.

claims.claim: Historical model choice uses ranks 2/4/8, residual shrinkage 2/12, optional mixture sizes 2/4, regularization 2/8, at most twelve validation/profile sweeps, thirty outer fitting sweeps, and twenty-five median bisections; the internal replacement margin is max(1e-4,0.5 paired SE). Further floors, initializations and validation dimensions are described directly from the source, not from unverified runtime diagnostics.
claims.source_scope: Static settings only; no assertion about realized component, fallback, or selector choices.

claims.claim: Random low-rank uses masked alternating ridge with ranks 2/4, penalties 0.1/1, eight validation sweeps and thirty final sweeps. Greedy ridge uses overlap-shrunk correlations with at least four pairs, n/(n+10) shrinkage, and penalty 0.1.
claims.source_scope: Readable evaluated baseline implementation, plus retained baseline observation records.

claims.claim: The designated reset replay matches selected columns and predictions under the evaluator check and is excluded from performance means. Candidate-generated diagnostics are explicitly unverified; no externally verified component ablations or additional dataset evaluations are provided.
